fields.acceptance: The workflow-new testscript shows the skeleton with no make test, the examples present, and workflow check flagging the placeholder, then passing once it is replaced.
fields.statement: rhiza workflow new without --from writes a skeleton whose test command is a placeholder, with comments on every field and example commands for Go, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust, plus a commented cleanup step and environment example; rhiza workflow check flags the placeholder until it is replaced.

fields.acceptance: A test runs rhiza workflow check on every example workflow under docs and passes.
fields.statement: The custom-workflows docs explain the cleanup phase and workflow environment, and the docs carry example workflows for Go, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, each one a file that passes rhiza workflow check.
